label: Waiting
legend: waiting for its dependencies to complete and merge

label: Queued
legend: ready; the daemon spawns a session when a slot frees up

label: Executing
legend: a session is working in the stage's worktree

label: Input
legend: the agent is waiting for an answer in its session

label: Handoff
legend: context ceiling reached; a fresh session resumes it

label: Completed
legend: work done and verified — may still be unmerged

label: Skipped
legend: skipped by you; does not satisfy its dependents

label: Blocked
legend: stopped; crashes auto-retry, else do what its note asks, then → loom stage retry <id>

label: Conflict
legend: merge conflict; a merge resolver session fixes it

label: MergeBlk
legend: merge errored (not a conflict); a resolver session fixes it

label: Review
legend: asked for a decision → loom stage human-review <id>

label: Adjudicate
legend: a disputed criterion (acceptance, wiring or wiring test) awaits the judge's verdict
